card.name: Words just before wounded or injuries
card.fires_on: Words and numbers right before an expected word like wounded, injured or injuries, in war, accident and crime reports. It fires on the slot where the next word would name harm.

modes.label: Casualty counts
modes.description: Digits in a count of casualties, just before the word wounded.

modes.label: Intensifiers before injured
modes.description: Adverbs or adjectives like seriously, badly or severe that come before injured or a wound word.
modes.example: nearly as many<< seriously>> injured. The Japanese lost 29

modes.label: Linking words before injuries
modes.description: Small words such as his or from that lead into injuries or a wound.
modes.example: made it to a hospital before dying from<< his>> injuries the

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict words for wounds and injuries, such as wounded, injured and injuries.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to say that someone was wounded or injured.
